name: cytochrome P450 family 2 subfamily C member 19
vipSummary_text: CYP2C19 is one of the key pharmacogenes involved in implementation of pharmacogenomics. It is involved in guidelines for antidepressants, clopidogrel and voriconazole ( go to list of all guidelines with CYP2C19 ). the nomenclature has been set by PharmVar , note that the reference sequence for CYP2C19 on hg38 is equivalent to CYP2C19*38 not CYP2C19*1 . the AMP tier 1 alleles are CYP2C19*2 , CYP2C19*3 and CYP2C19*17 see all alleles on the AMP recommended to test list key variant pages are rs4244285 (part of *2), rs4986893 (part of *3) and rs12248560 (part of *17) See the Gene-specific Information Tables for Allele Definitions (for which variants comprise which star alleles), Allele function assignments (normal function, no function, decreased or increased function etc) and Diplotype-Phenotype Table (for how the alleles combine to form metabolizer phenotypes for PM, NM, UM)

name: cytochrome P450 family 2 subfamily D member 6
vipSummary_text: CYP2D6 is one of the key pharmacogenes involved in implementation of pharmacogenomics. It is highly polymorphic and involved in the metabolism of up to 25% of the drugs that are in common use in the clinic. It is involved in guidelines for codeine and other opioids, antidepressants, and tamoxifen go to list of all guidelines with CYP2D6 . the nomenclature has been set by PharmVar . the AMP tier 1 alleles are CYP2D6*2 , CYP2D6*3 , CYP2D6*4 , CYP2D6*5 , CYP2D6*6 , CYP2D6*9 , CYP2D6*10 , CYP2D6*17 , CYP2D6*29 , CYP2D6*41 , CYP2D6 duplications and other copy number variants see all alleles on the AMP recommended to test list . See the Gene-specific Information Tables for Allele Definitions (for which variants comprise which star alleles), Allele function assignments (normal function, no function, decreased or increased function etc) and Diplotype-Phenotype Table (for how the alleles combine to form metabolizer phenotypes for PM, NM, UM). CYP2D6 is the most studied CYP for phenoconversion, where a drug-drug interaction mimics a metabolizer phenotype. paroxetine , fluoxetine and bupropion are strong inhibitors of CYP2D6 as per Flockhart Table .

name: cytochrome P450 family 2 subfamily C member 9

It is involved in guidelines for warfarin , phenytoin and NSAIDs , ( go to list of all guidelines with CYP2C9 ). the nomenclature has been set by PharmVar the AMP tier 1 alleles are CYP2C9*2 , CYP2C9*3 , CYP2C9*5 , CYP2C9*6 , CYP2C9*8 , and CYP2C9*11 , see all alleles on the AMP recommended to test list key variant pages include rs1799853 and rs1057910 See the Gene-specific Information Tables for Allele Definitions (for which variants comprise which star alleles), Allele function assignments (normal function, no function, decreased or increased function etc) and Diplotype-Phenotype Table (for how the alleles combine to form metabolizer phenotypes for PM, NM, UM)

name: cytochrome P450 family 3 subfamily A member 4
vipSummary_text: CYP3A4 is one of the key pharmacogenes involved in implementation of pharmacogenomics. It is involved in guidelines for quetiapine ( go to list of all guidelines with CYP3A4 ). the nomenclature has been set by PharmVar the AMP tier 1 allele is CYP3A4*22 and tier 2 allele is CYP3A4*20 see all alleles on the AMP recommended to test list . key variant pages are rs35599367 (defining for *22) and rs67666821 (defining for *20). it is involved in many drug label annotations with a larger number of cautions for drug-drug interactions with CYP3A4 inhibitors (such as ketoconazole ) and inducers (such as carbamazepine ), see the Flockhart table for more CYP3A4 inhibitors, inducers and substrates.

name: cytochrome P450 family 1 subfamily A member 2
vipSummary_text: CYP1A2 is an inducible member of the cytochrome P450 (CYP) drug metabolizing gene family, important for metabolism of caffeine and antipsychotics.
